None of the photo vault apps we investigated provide genuine data encryption. Essentially, these apps only offer a passcode screen as a form of protection when the application is launched. Consequently, the data stored in your phone remains unencrypted and susceptible to easy access.

In contrast, Privoto employs robust security measures by encrypting all imported photos and videos with a 256-bit encryption key.
